text: I bet you $100 you've already seen the GTA VI map, because Rockstar didn't invent Vice
City.
They copied it.
From Miami.
A hotel strip copied right down to the palm trees.
An apartment building that doesn't exist anymore, except in the game.
A swamp, a sugar town, a giant lobster that turned into a whale, and mountains in a state
whose highest point is 105 meters.
GTA VI launches November 19th, so let's put the trailers next to the real map, and
at the end, I'll show you the moment Miami started copying the game back. Grab a controller
and a map of Florida. 10 stops. Stop 1. Ocean Drive, Miami Beach. Pastel, Art Deco, Hotels,
neon signs, palm trees, and the beach right across the road. In the trailers, it's called
Hotel Victor becomes Hotel Dixon, and here's the thing.
Rockstar has copied this street before.
In 2002's Vice City, that same colony hotel
was the Colon Hotel.
Same building, copied twice, 24 years apart.
That hotel is still standing, but a few blocks away,
two towers are slowly going down.
It's just past 8.30 in the evening,
and the collapse occurred right now.
